facts.business: MTAR Technologies Limited develops and manufactures critical, technology-intensive products for strategic sectors including Civil Nuclear, Aerospace & Defence, and Clean Energy, with a focus on precision engineering and manufacturing.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Four reactor tenders for construction of 700 MWe reactors at Mahibanswara is expected in F27
Approximately Rs.1500 Mn from the refurbishment of existing nuclear reactors in FY 27

key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to varying incoterms and delivery specifications across customer arrangements
Dependence on strategic sectors with high entry barriers and long gestation periods
Concentration risk in Civil Nuclear and Aerospace & Defence sectors
